purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Marakwet West Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 200 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This is a 3-page form; page 2 carries both the FORM 34B header confirming CON 148 / county code 028 and the final shaded green TOTAL row, with the returning officer/agent signatures directly below it on the same page. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt); the whole form is a scanned raster, so all values were read visually from the rendered page image and cross-confirmed with an independent 300 DPI crop of the shaded TOTAL row. The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.
